sections.name: Burgers
sections.description: Half-pound patties, ground behind the bar, cooked on the grill in front of you.

items.name: Peanut Butter & Bacon Burger
items.description: Half-pound patty, peanut butter, bacon. One of Visit Eau Claire's ten iconic Eau Claire eats.
items.story:
People hear the name and stop. Then they order it again the next time they are in.

The patty is ground behind the bar and cooked on the grill you can see from your stool. The peanut butter goes on hot so it runs into the bacon. That is the whole trick.

Visit Eau Claire put it on their list of ten iconic Eau Claire eats.

items.name: Olive Burger
items.description: Half-pound patty with green olives. The regulars' order.
items.story: Green olives on a half-pound burger. It reads like a mistake and eats like it was always supposed to be there. Ask the bar how long it has been on the menu; nobody agrees.
